title: NSGo game variables and switches (version 1)
description: VarsDoc is the root of a versioned vars.yaml declaration file.

version.description: Version is the schema version; it must equal VarsFormatVersion (1).

vars.description: Vars declares the project's shared game variables and switches in declaration order.

VarDecl.description: VarDecl declares one project-wide game variable or switch.

name.description: Name uniquely identifies the variable; it must start with a letter or '_' followed by letters, digits, or '_'.

kind.description: Kind is the variable's declared type: "bool", "int", "float", or "string".

default.description: Default is the variable's initial value when omitted or reset; nil uses the zero value for Kind (false, 0, 0.0, or "").

min.description: Min is an optional inclusive lower bound for "int" and "float" variables.

max.description: Max is an optional inclusive upper bound for "int" and "float" variables.

doc.description: Doc is an optional description for editors, inspectors, and designers.
